metrics.label: Bollinger %B
metrics.gloss: where the close sits in the Bollinger envelope, (close − lower) / (upper − lower) — 0 at the lower band, 1 at the upper, outside [0,1] when price trades beyond them

metrics.label: 20-bar high
metrics.gloss: the highest high of the 20-bar window ending at this bar — the Donchian channel's upper edge

metrics.label: 20-bar low
metrics.gloss: the lowest low of the 20-bar window ending at this bar — the Donchian channel's lower edge

metrics.label: Prior 20-bar high
metrics.gloss: the highest high of the 20-bar window ending at the bar before this one — the upper edge a close at this bar can break (Pine's ta.highest(high, 20)[1])

metrics.label: Prior 20-bar low
metrics.gloss: the lowest low of the 20-bar window ending at the bar before this one — the lower edge a close at this bar can break (Pine's ta.lowest(low, 20)[1])

metrics.label: Broken 20-bar high
metrics.gloss: the prior 20-bar high a close most recently broke above, held until a later close falls back below it, a further break replaces it, or the break ages out; absent while no break is unrecovered

metrics.label: Broken 20-bar low
metrics.gloss: the prior 20-bar low a close most recently broke below, held until a later close rises back above it, a further break replaces it, or the break ages out; absent while no break is unrecovered

metrics.label: VWAP (UTC day)
metrics.gloss: volume-weighted average price accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor

metrics.label: Price zone
metrics.gloss: price location against the channel of the 20 bars before this one, near an edge in its outer 20%

metrics.label: Band touch
metrics.gloss: price contact with a Bollinger band: %B below 0.05 touches the lower band, above 0.95 the upper

metrics.label: Structure zones
metrics.gloss: the ACTIVE structure-zone set (fair-value gaps and order blocks)

metrics.label: TPO point of control
metrics.gloss: the price bin holding the most time in the current UTC day, over 5-bps bins — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes

metrics.label: TPO value-area high
metrics.gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area around the current UTC day's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes

metrics.label: TPO value-area low
metrics.gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area around the current UTC day's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes

metrics.label: Initial balance high
metrics.gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day's first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that initial balance closes

metrics.label: Initial balance low
metrics.gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day's first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that initial balance closes

metrics.label: TPO profile shape
metrics.gloss: where the point of control sits inside the current UTC day's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror — a point-in-time read at its own fold

metrics.label: TPO point of control (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC day

metrics.label: TPO value-area high (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% value area

metrics.label: TPO value-area low (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% value area

metrics.label: TPO profile shape (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: where the point of control sat inside the previous completed UTC day's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror

metrics.label: Initial balance high (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: the highest price of the previous completed UTC day's first 60 minutes

metrics.label: Initial balance low (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: the lowest price of the previous completed UTC day's first 60 minutes

metrics.label: Volume point of control
metrics.gloss: the price bin holding the most typical-price-weighted VOLUME in the current UTC day — the volume sibling of tpoPOC, published beside it rather than replacing it, because time-at-price and volume-at-price disagree exactly where a UTC day ranged quietly or trended hard. Null where the UTC day traded nothing the fold can see — a point-in-time read at its own fold

metrics.label: Volume value-area high
metrics.gloss: the upper edge of the current UTC day's 70% VOLUME value area — the same expansion rule as tpoVAH, over the volume tally — a point-in-time read at its own fold

metrics.label: Volume value-area low
metrics.gloss: the lower edge of the current UTC day's 70% VOLUME value area — a point-in-time read at its own fold

metrics.label: Volume point of control (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: the price bin that held the most typical-price-weighted volume in the previous completed UTC day

metrics.label: Volume value-area high (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% volume value area

metrics.label: Volume value-area low (prior UTC day)
metrics.gloss: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% volume value area

metrics.label: Naked POC above
metrics.gloss: the nearest point of control above the price that no later UTC day has traded through, over the 60 retained UTC days back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which level qualifies — and its dist_nPocAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

metrics.label: Naked POC below
metrics.gloss: the nearest point of control below the price that no later UTC day has traded through, over the 60 retained UTC days back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which level qualifies — and its dist_nPocBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive

metrics.label: Single print above
metrics.gloss: the low edge of the nearest single-print zone above the price in the current UTC day's letter profile, excluding a zone the price has reached since the fold — read live, because the price decides which zone is nearest — and its dist_tpoSpAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

metrics.label: Single print below
metrics.gloss: the high edge of the nearest single-print zone below the price in the current UTC day's letter profile, excluding a zone the price has reached since the fold — read live, because the price decides which zone is nearest — and its dist_tpoSpBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive

metrics.label: Naked single print above
metrics.gloss: the low edge of the nearest earlier UTC day's single-print zone above the price that no later trading has touched, over the retained UTC days whose single prints were measured, back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which zone qualifies — and its dist_nSpAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

metrics.label: Naked single print below
metrics.gloss: the high edge of the nearest earlier UTC day's single-print zone below the price that no later trading has touched, over the retained UTC days whose single prints were measured, back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which zone qualifies — and its dist_nSpBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive

metrics.label: Asia 00–08 UTC high
metrics.gloss: the highest price of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session so far (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: Asia 00–08 UTC low
metrics.gloss: the lowest price of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session so far (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: Asia 00–08 UTC open
metrics.gloss: the opening print of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: Asia 00–08 UTC high (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the high of the previous completed Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: Asia 00–08 UTC low (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the low of the previous completed Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: Asia 00–08 UTC open (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the opening print of the previous completed Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: Asia 00–08 UTC high swept
metrics.gloss: whether any price since the previous Asia 00–08 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly above its high: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

metrics.label: Asia 00–08 UTC low swept
metrics.gloss: whether any price since the previous Asia 00–08 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly below its low: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

metrics.label: London 08–13 UTC high
metrics.gloss: the highest price of the current London 08–13 UTC trading session so far (08:00–13:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: London 08–13 UTC low
metrics.gloss: the lowest price of the current London 08–13 UTC trading session so far (08:00–13:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: London 08–13 UTC open
metrics.gloss: the opening print of the current London 08–13 UTC trading session (08:00–13:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: London 08–13 UTC high (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the high of the previous completed London 08–13 UTC trading session (08:00–13:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: London 08–13 UTC low (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the low of the previous completed London 08–13 UTC trading session (08:00–13:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: London 08–13 UTC open (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the opening print of the previous completed London 08–13 UTC trading session (08:00–13:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: London 08–13 UTC high swept
metrics.gloss: whether any price since the previous London 08–13 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly above its high: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

metrics.label: London 08–13 UTC low swept
metrics.gloss: whether any price since the previous London 08–13 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly below its low: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

metrics.label: New York 13–21 UTC high
metrics.gloss: the highest price of the current New York 13–21 UTC trading session so far (13:00–21:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: New York 13–21 UTC low
metrics.gloss: the lowest price of the current New York 13–21 UTC trading session so far (13:00–21:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: New York 13–21 UTC open
metrics.gloss: the opening print of the current New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

metrics.label: New York 13–21 UTC high (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the high of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: New York 13–21 UTC low (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the low of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: New York 13–21 UTC open (previous instance)
metrics.gloss: the opening print of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

metrics.label: New York 13–21 UTC high swept
metrics.gloss: whether any price since the previous New York 13–21 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly above its high: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

metrics.label: New York 13–21 UTC low swept
metrics.gloss: whether any price since the previous New York 13–21 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly below its low: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

metrics.label: Opening range high (15m)
metrics.gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day's first 15 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

metrics.label: Opening range low (15m)
metrics.gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day's first 15 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

metrics.label: Opening range high (30m)
metrics.gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day's first 30 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

metrics.label: Opening range low (30m)
metrics.gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day's first 30 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

metrics.label: IB extension up (1.5×)
metrics.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance high plus 0.5 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB low reaches 1.5× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

metrics.label: IB extension down (1.5×)
metrics.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance low minus 0.5 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB high reaches 1.5× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

metrics.label: IB extension up (2×)
metrics.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance high plus 1 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB low reaches 2× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

metrics.label: IB extension down (2×)
metrics.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance low minus 1 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB high reaches 2× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

metrics.label: Bollinger upper band
metrics.gloss: the upper Bollinger band (20, 2σ), a price level

metrics.label: Bollinger lower band
metrics.gloss: the lower Bollinger band (20, 2σ), a price level

metrics.label: Keltner upper
metrics.gloss: the upper Keltner channel, EMA20 + 1.5 × ATR20

metrics.label: Keltner lower
metrics.gloss: the lower Keltner channel, EMA20 − 1.5 × ATR20

metrics.label: Supertrend stop
metrics.gloss: the Supertrend trailing stop (ATR 10, ×3) — the lower band while bullish, the upper while bearish

metrics.label: Swing high (fractal 2/2)
metrics.gloss: the high of the most recent swing high — at or above the 2 highs before it and strictly above the 2 after it (Pine's ta.pivothigh tie rule) — published from the bar that completes its right side and held until the next swing high, or until it leaves reach

metrics.label: Swing low (fractal 2/2)
metrics.gloss: the low of the most recent swing low — at or below the 2 lows before it and strictly below the 2 after it (Pine's ta.pivotlow tie rule) — published from the bar that completes its right side and held until the next swing low, or until it leaves reach

metrics.label: Prior swing high (fractal 2/2)
metrics.gloss: the high of the decided swing high before the most recent one, while it is in reach — the pivot the structure label compares a swing high with

metrics.label: Prior swing low (fractal 2/2)
metrics.gloss: the low of the decided swing low before the most recent one, while it is in reach — the pivot the structure label compares a swing low with

metrics.label: Swing high age (bars)
metrics.gloss: the bars from the most recent swing high's own bar to this bar — 2 on the bar that completes its right side, one more per bar after it

metrics.label: Swing low age (bars)
metrics.gloss: the bars from the most recent swing low's own bar to this bar — 2 on the bar that completes its right side, one more per bar after it

metrics.label: Swing structure
metrics.gloss: the most recent decided swing pivot (2 bars each side) against the previous pivot on its own side: HH or LH for a swing high (an equal high is LH), HL or LL for a swing low (an equal low is HL), none when no comparable pair is in reach — a state held between pivots, not an event

metrics.label: Parabolic SAR
metrics.gloss: the parabolic SAR stop level (step 0.02, max 0.2)

metrics.label: Pivot
metrics.gloss: the floor pivot, (the previous UTC day’s high + low + close) / 3

metrics.label: Pivot R1
metrics.gloss: the first floor resistance pivot, 2P − the previous UTC day’s low

metrics.label: Pivot R2
metrics.gloss: the second floor resistance pivot, P + the previous UTC day’s range

metrics.label: Pivot R3
metrics.gloss: the third floor resistance pivot, the previous UTC day’s high + 2 × (P − that day’s low)

metrics.label: Pivot S1
metrics.gloss: the first floor support pivot, 2P − the previous UTC day’s high

metrics.label: Pivot S2
metrics.gloss: the second floor support pivot, P − the previous UTC day’s range

metrics.label: Previous-day high
metrics.gloss: the previous UTC day’s high — the literal prior-day extreme, not a tracked swing pivot

metrics.label: Previous-day low
metrics.gloss: the previous UTC day’s low — the literal prior-day extreme, not a tracked swing pivot

metrics.label: Previous-day open
metrics.gloss: the previous UTC day’s opening print — the literal prior-day open, not a tracked swing pivot

metrics.label: Pivot S3
metrics.gloss: the third floor support pivot, the previous UTC day’s low − 2 × (that day’s high − P)

studies.label: Bollinger Bands (20, 2)
studies.gloss: bands 2 standard deviations either side of the 20-period SMA of close — the middle band is SMA (20) itself — and where the close sits between them

studies.label: Keltner Channels (20, 1.5)
studies.gloss: channel lines 1.5 × the 20-period ATR either side of the basis, the 20-period EMA of close — offered as EMA (20) itself

studies.label: Donchian Channels (20)
studies.gloss: the highest high and lowest low of the last 20 bars, the same edges as of the bar before, the edge a close most recently broke through, and where price sits between the edges

studies.label: Swing fractal (2/2)
studies.gloss: the most recent swing high and low — a bar at least as extreme as the 2 bars before it and more extreme than the 2 after it — the prior swing high and low before them, how each latest pivot compares with its prior one, and how many bars ago each latest pivot printed

studies.label: UTC day profile
studies.gloss: the current UTC day's time and volume profile — point of control, value area and initial balance

studies.label: Prior UTC day profile
studies.gloss: the previous completed UTC day's time and volume profile

studies.label: Prior day
studies.gloss: the previous UTC day's high, open and low

studies.label: Floor pivots
studies.gloss: the floor pivot and its three resistance and three support levels, from the previous UTC day's high, low and close

studies.label: Naked POC
studies.gloss: the nearest earlier points of control above and below price that no later UTC day has traded through

studies.label: Single prints
studies.gloss: the nearest single-print zones above and below price — rows of a UTC day's letter profile only one TPO period traded through — in the current UTC day, and in earlier UTC days where no later trading has touched them

studies.label: Trading sessions
studies.gloss: the current trading session's high, low and open for Asia 00–08 UTC, London 08–13 UTC and New York 13–21 UTC, each read only while that trading session is the current one

studies.label: Prior trading sessions
studies.gloss: the previous completed instance of each named trading session — its high, low and open — and whether price has swept its high or low since

studies.label: Opening range
studies.gloss: the high and low of the current UTC day's first 15 and 30 minutes

studies.label: Initial-balance extensions
studies.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance high and low pushed out by 0.5 and 1 of its range — where the day's range reaches 1.5× and 2× the initial balance

metrics.gloss: players in this session
share of the field’s directional picks that are up (%); absent when no bias has been measured
the direction the field leans, derived from the share; absent whenever the bias is, and at an exact 50/50 where no side dominates
share of captain picks landing on the single most-captained coin (%)
distinct coins picked, over distinct coins available
share of the scope's coins that closed up (%), over the universe it was measured across
share of the scope's coins that closed down (%), over the universe it was measured across
net breadth — the up share minus the down share (%), signed; negative is a broadly red field
mean close-change across the scope (%), signed

spread of close-change across the scope (%, standard deviation) — how much the field disagrees; low means the coins moved together and a cohort-wide read describes them, high means the mean hides a wide range and the field is moving further per bar
share of the scope's coins carrying a positive PPO histogram (%), over the coins that have one
share of the scope's coins carrying a negative PPO histogram (%), over the coins that have one
net momentum breadth — the positive-histogram share minus the negative (%), signed; negative is a field losing momentum
mean PPO histogram across the scope, signed

mean relative volume across the scope, each coin against its own 20-bar baseline (1.0 = the field at its own normal, 2.0 = twice it) — how much of the field is actually participating; on the stock and commodity scopes it also reads whether the underlying cash session is open, since those perps trade when their underlying markets are shut

mean RSI(14) across the scope — how extended the field already is, and a slow-moving state rather than a reversal trigger: elevated readings have tended to persist and to run with the move, not against it; the reading is sharpest on the tight crypto cohorts, since averaging the whole tracked universe pulls it toward the midpoint
USDT/USD deviation from par (%), signed, from Coinbase’s USDT-USD spot tape quoted in USD; read as of its latest stored minute close and absent when that close is older than 15 minutes
USDC/USDT deviation from par (%), signed, from Binance’s USDCUSDT spot tape quoted in USDT; read as of its latest stored minute close and absent when that close is older than 15 minutes
